_comment: Compose with: node tools/screenshots/compose.mjs apps/color-sort/store/screenshots.json apps/color-sort/store/screenshots/en-US. Raw captures come from app-verify (apps/color-sort/qa) and are copied into store/raw. Shot 1 is the win, because it is the picture that makes someone want the app; shots 2 and 4 are the wedge said plainly — a rack that is always winnable, and an app with nothing in it that runs out. The background is the brand's own deep water, not a generic navy.
